content: Itou nomo kot no tigini.

Onou waha bona, tere fai oruwanga nere ila genege beele tafaya waha, ji tere etenga-etenga letigini, ne benou lewei nomo edo uwa, ne nyabuluwou uwau. Isau. Saini ne nere ila genege beele tafani waha, ne nage fere geete beele tafani, taate bona, nere fanyinege onode waha, ne nage fere fanyite onounga ono-ononi.
Ere isiya, nere fai onowou inyaba onode waha, Itou no nere agou inyaba kabaka nigi-nigina, onodu Itou no fanyimu onou onona waha, no gai tigini.
Nere fai fanyinege onou onode waha, ne genege beele tafa‑tafani. Onou wa, ne nage fere nere fanyinege onode onounga ono-ononi. Ne ninate isini, Itou no ne nage fere kot langa ada tafa hinona yo?

Adadu? Itou no ne saini ufaro onowou hilobainga ono hini bona itari hinina. No agou inyaba kabaka fasayadu ada hinina. Ne Itou nomo onowou hilobainga ureni wa, no dada ewe dorofe rute? Itou no ne huwanyate ubuluwei nomo bona gau tuganga, onowou hilobainga ono hinina. Ne waha ada rute isini?

Ne name huwanyate danga bagu sesemu boni, ne huwanyate ada ubuluni. Onodu onowou waha langa, ne nage name agou inyaba ago anyakaro komomuni dorofe. Onodu fati Itou no nomo kot tigini waha yaasu wona langa, no nomo houmu mayou malala heigonga, ne agou inyaba waha tau ganga.
Itou “no fai-aita oruwanga nere fanyimu ono wane waha agou inyaba kabaka nigonbona.”

Nere ila fanyimu hilobainga danga bagu oojo bode, ha laluwa langa Itou bagu yafade bode, unyinege anyaro bagu, agenege auma usuwou uwau tei nomo jala kuruwou haruwe tede. Itou no nere fai-aita waha, agenege auma gai-gai yafagou waha nigonbona.
Onodu nere ila, nere nage bodenga isi bode, nere beele ngalenga moge tubode, nere onowou hilou uwa waha oojode. Itou no fai-aita waha bona houmu mayonga, no agou gai inyaba kabaka nigonbona.
Ou anyaro jimiri bagu nere fai oruwanga onowou inyaba onode langa heige nigonbona, nere Juda amuge gogunga nere fai-aita bagu fereha fere.

Onou wa, Itou no ha laluwa langa yafou hilobainga, unyinege anyaro, huwananege foinga inyei nomo waha, nere fai oruwanga onowou hilobainga ono-onode waha nigonbona. Nere Juda amuge gogunga, nere fai-aita bagu fereha fere.
Itou no fai-aita oruwanga onowou hogo etenga langanga haawe nigi-nigina, edo nere fai fereha.

Wa onou. Nere fai oruwanga nuuni beele uwau nere une tafade waha, nere yaae wodbode wahanga. Edo nere nuuni beele uwau. Nere fai oruwanga, nere nuuni beele isi bode une tafade waha, Itou no nuuni beele langa beele inyina waha oojo bona nebere onowou haawe nagon bona.
Nere fai nuuni beele ewe iside, nere Itou ago langa fai tigini ada heigode. Uwa. Nere fai nuuni beele oojode wahanga, Itou no nere fai tigini nigonbona.

Nere fai-aita bagu fereha waha nere nuuni beele uwau. Onode wa, nere ila nere nage nebere ninanege langa nuuni beele nomo onowou oojo-oojode. Nere nuuni beele uwau. Onou wa, nere nuuni beele nomo onowou oojowei mata wogunga wa, nere nage nebere ninanege no, nere nebere nuuni beele dorofe inyina.

Nere nebere fanyinege waha langa, Itou no nuuni beele nere huwanyanege gamu langa yeregai waha, malala heigena. Onodu ninanege tigini nere huwanyanege langa inyina waha fere, nuuni beele nere huwanyanege langa inyina waha abitimuna. Onou waha bona, saini Itou no nere fai oruwanga nebere onowou huwari bagu, nebere beele huwari bagu haawe nagei nomo fati hangadawai langa, nere fai waha nebere ninanege no nere fanyimu ono wane waha kot langa tafa nigonbona. Onodu saini ila nere fanyimu ono wane waha bona no edo nigona rute. Hilou beele ji malalamudu leni waha no benou lena, Itou no fai oruwanga nebere onowou haawe nagei nomo haruwe, Yesus Kristus tuwonbona.
Nere Juda ninanege iside, nuuni beele no edo hoyo nigonbona.
Onou wa, ji elebe tere Juda bagu beele bagu, tere nuuni beele no edo kot langa hoyo tigona iya yo. Tere tage tebere unyitege jaimu boya benou le-leya, “Ere Itou nomo fai.”
Tere Itou nomo gauwou tere alai. Tere nuuni beele boya sisiwou amina teiha, onou waha boya, tere benou le-leya, onowou tigini wa hilobainga.

Tere benou isi-isiya, “Nuuni beele langa ere isou hilobainga bagu beele ngalenga nomo hugu amina teiha, onou waha boya ere nere agenege fosokowou jala edo abitimu nigo boya. Nere fai agugu langa yafade waha nebere lalawou dorofe ere yafaya. Ere fai isou uwau waha isisiwou nigei nomo fai. Ere magana mene-mene nebere isisiwou fai.”
Yo, tere fai‑aita bagu ila isisiwou nigi-nigiya. Onou wa, tere taate boya tere tage isisiwou tegu uwa? Tere le-leya, nere fai adai yebu wode. Onou wa, tere tage yebu‑yebuya rute?

Tere le-leya, “Nere fai-aita bagu te guruwou, nere longi fanyimu adai ono wogu iya.” Onoya wa, tere tage onou rute ono-onoya? Tere yaawa itou ada gau nigi-nigiya, onoya wa, tere haiden nebere bori mata nomo dada yebu-yebuya rute?
Tere tage tebere unyitege jaimu boya le-leya, “Ere Itou nomo nuuni beele alai”. Onou wa, tere tage nuuni beele feiya-feiyaya rute, onodu onowou waha langa tere Itou nomo unyi inyabamu fufuya.
Itou nomo buk langa onowou waha bona beele benou bagu. “Tere tebere nyabuluwou langanga, nere fai-aita fereha waha memesi beele lebode, Itou unyi ilei-ileide.”
Genege gala karuwei nomo fanyimu tigini.

Ngalenga, ne nuuni beele oojo bonahe wonga, Juda ebere fanyige langa geege gala karuwei nomo wa, onowou hilobainga. Onou wa, ne nuuni beele feiyawei mata bonahe wonga, edo ne geete gala karu hanane, ariya ne fai no gogala karu fuwegu uwa dorofe yafani.
Onodu fai no gogala karu fuwegu uwa, no nuuni beele nomo onowou hilou oruwanga oojowei mata wona wa, fai waha no gogala karu fuwane dorofe yafana.

Ngalenga, Juda tere nuuni beele nomo buk bagu, onodu tere getege gala karu tagane. Onou wa, tere nuuni beele feiyawei mata bonade wonga edo, fai no gogala karu fuwegu uwa no nuuni beele ngalenga oojona waha, no tere getege beele tafonbona.
Fai no ewe Juda unyi langanga yafa bona wonga, no Juda tigini uwa. Onodu genege gala karuwou nomo fanyimu waha, no ewe genege gala nomonga dada uwa.

Fai no nomo ninau langa, no nomo huwanya langa no Juda yafana waha, no Juda tigini. Onodu genege gala karuwei nomo fanyimu tigini waha fere, fai nomo huwanya langa nomo ninau langa heigona. No beele oojowou fanyimu nuuni beele la yeregane waha langa ada heige-heigena. Uwa. Wa Itou nomo hauri we heigemuna. Fai onouha waha, nere fai agenege langa no unyi anyakaro ada te-tena. Uwa. No Itou ago langa unyi anyakaro bagu.
